jobs: Himalayas API (including searches filtered to Kenya)
employer job pages on Greenhouse, Recruitee, Workable, PeopleForce and SmartRecruiters

method.filtering_summary: Of about 2,880 postings pulled, about 300 were more than 30 days old, about 1,210 had senior, lead or manager titles, about 910 weren’t target roles, and about 140 were limited to regions that exclude Kenya. Most of the roughly 310 left failed on a closer read, usually on years of experience or a location rule in the posting itself.

stories.title: Liquid AI releases open-weight d1 decision models
stories.summary: d1-3B and d1-omni-600M are on Hugging Face; d1-3B answers in 8 ms on an RTX 4090 and produces an answer in a single forward pass instead of tokens.
stories.why: Small, fast models suit cheap on-device routing and classification steps in agent pipelines.

stories.title: Cohere Labs releases Tiny Aya L2-Thinker
stories.summary: Open 3.35B model that reasons in the prompt language over 93% of the time across 60 languages; weights and reasoning data released.
stories.why: A small open model worth testing for Kiswahili-facing products.

stories.title: LiteLLM open-sources Moyai, a self-hosted cloud coding agent
stories.summary: Runs Claude Code or Codex on 100+ providers; LiteLLM says it would have cost about $21,700 against a $101,872 monthly Devin bill.
stories.why: A concrete, self-hostable example of background coding agents he could study or run.

stories.title: AWS previews Strands Box, an open-source sandbox for AI agents
stories.summary: Developer-preview local sandbox that pairs operating-system isolation with Dogwood semantic policy.
stories.why: Agent safety and sandboxing are becoming part of the agent-engineering job.

stories.title: Nous Research raises $90M at a $1.5B valuation
stories.summary: Series B led by Robot Ventures (Nvidia, USV, Menlo among backers); total funding $158 million; launching "Hermes for Businesses" agents.
stories.why: A well-funded open-source agent company moving into enterprise, likely hiring agent engineers.

stories.title: Siena raises $17M Series A for AI agents for consumer brands
stories.summary: York IE led the round, bringing total funding to $29.7 million; building customer-service, shopping and social agents.
stories.why: Another agentic-AI startup with fresh money to hire.

stories.title: FINCA Ventures grants go to six African startups, four of them Kenyan
stories.summary: Grants of $40,000 to $100,000; Kenya's VunaPay got $100,000 for co-op payments and credit, and nesti $60,000 for rent-based credit histories.
stories.why: Kenyan fintechs building payment and credit infrastructure close to his Kwara work.

stories.title: Stanford study: AI-exposed jobs for 22-25-year-olds 19% below trend
stories.summary: In jobs like customer service and software engineering, employment for ages 22-25 is 19% lower than if it had kept pace since 2022; no gap for experienced workers.
stories.why: Junior roles are scarcer where AI automates tasks, so showing AI-building skills matters.

stories.title: Amazon makes fresh job cuts, mainly in its retail unit
stories.summary: Fewer than 1,000 white-collar jobs cut, according to a person familiar, after an earlier round of 30,000; staff in the US, India and the UK affected.
stories.why: Big-tech cuts keep adding experienced people to the remote job pool.

stories.title: Equity's Finserve pilots Emma, a new mobile money wallet
stories.summary: Pilot wallet on Google Play (100+ downloads) to send, receive, borrow, save and pay; sign-up in the app, via *765# or the Equitel SIM toolkit.
stories.why: A new M-PESA rival means more Kenyan wallet and payments integration work.

stories.title: Safaricom's Jumbe SMS proves M-PESA payments without showing your balance
stories.summary: "Split Notifications" send a second SMS with the transaction code, amount, business, Till and time, plus a JumbeID instead of name and number.
stories.why: Shows how M-PESA's merchant APIs and notifications are changing.
